name: Tounosawa Genki
source:
Favorite Food: Tera Mac
Pure Downtown Boy

He's in the same class as Taiga and hangs out with him a lot.
The head of the soccer club.
Besides his schoolwork he helps his grandmother run the bathhouse she owns. He's lived with her since he was small after his parents left for India
He loves kids and often goes to the park on his days off to play games with them.
